evals.prompt: argocd_exec виснет и ничего не возвращает, до этого всё нормально работало. Что могло случиться?
evals.expected_output: Leads with the VPN/DNS gotcha as the first thing to check (internal hostnames resolve to a public wildcard when off VPN, causing silent hangs rather than a clean error), gives the dig +short argocd.infra.sonar-corp.ru check with the expected 192.168.88.106 answer, and also suggests checking auth session status (argocd_auth_status) as a secondary cause. Should not jump straight into app-level sync debugging before ruling out connectivity.

evals.prompt: My pod for payments-billing-api is stuck in Pending and the Argo CD app shows OutOfSync too — any idea what's going on?
evals.expected_output: Gives argocd_exec commands to inspect (app get, app resources/logs) and names at least one platform-specific Pending cause (node selector using a short hostname instead of the FQDN kubernetes.io/hostname value, or a local-path PV pinned to a different/dead node). Should distinguish this from generic Kubernetes advice by citing the sonar-prod-specific gotchas rather than only generic 'check events/describe pod' guidance.
